data.name: Nik
data.gender_notes: Nik is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Niketana’, meaning ‘victorious’. In Hindu mythology, Nik represents the triumphant spirit of the warrior Arjuna. The name Nik carries the meaning “Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nik usually hope their child will grow to embody victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nik total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
